context: Tests whether the agent correctly configures Kubernetes metadata enrichment for an OpenTelemetry Collector, including proper k8sattributes pod association order, extraction of both workload name and UID, consistent enrichment across all signal pipelines, correct processor ordering, and cluster-level static attributes via the resource processor.

checklist.name: Enrichment on all pipelines
checklist.description: Both k8sattributes (or resourcedetection) AND resource processors appear in the processors list of ALL three pipelines: traces, metrics, AND logs — not just one or two

checklist.name: k8s.pod.uid first in pod_association
checklist.description: In the k8sattributes pod_association, the entry using 'from: resource_attribute' with name 'k8s.pod.uid' appears BEFORE the 'from: connection' entry

checklist.name: Workload name and UID extracted
checklist.description: The k8sattributes extract.metadata list includes BOTH k8s.deployment.name AND k8s.deployment.uid (both name and UID, not just one)

checklist.name: resourcedetection override false
checklist.description: The resourcedetection processor has override: false configured (not override: true or missing)

checklist.name: resource processor for cluster attributes
checklist.description: A resource processor is configured and sets at least one cluster-level attribute (e.g., k8s.cluster.name) using action: upsert or action: insert

checklist.name: Processor ordering: enrichment after memory_limiter
checklist.description: In each pipeline, memory_limiter appears before resourcedetection and/or k8sattributes (enrichment processors come after memory_limiter)

checklist.name: Processor ordering: resource after enrichment
checklist.description: In each pipeline, the resource processor (static attributes) appears AFTER resourcedetection and k8sattributes (not before them)

checklist.name: k8sattributes passthrough: false
checklist.description: The k8sattributes processor has passthrough: false (appropriate for a Collector that performs the Kubernetes API lookup itself)

checklist.name: memory_limiter first
checklist.description: memory_limiter is the first processor in every pipeline's processor list

checklist.name: k8s.cluster.uid kube-system reference
checklist.description: The configuration or accompanying documentation/comments references retrieving k8s.cluster.uid from the kube-system namespace (e.g., via kubectl get namespace kube-system -o jsonpath='{.metadata.uid}' or a placeholder comment explaining how to set it)

checklist.name: No batch processor
checklist.description: The configuration does NOT include a batch processor in any pipeline
